_comment: Ability modifiers DLF draws on every hero's world healthbar for a spectator (OVERHEAD_DRAW_FOR_EVERYONE, not hidden), so the top-bar debuff column can show them. Applied by dlf/scripts/spectator_status.py to the installed game's scripts/abilities.vdata and scripts/modifiers.vdata at build time. A modifier is named by its _my_subclass_name inside the ability record; buff: true lets the top bar show that ability's non-debuff statuses too (coloured as the hero's own team). minStacks: the status shows on the top bar only from that many stacks (Djinn's Mark: 8, user decision 2026-10-14). stun: true with no modifiers lists an ability only for its generic stun (Victor's ultimate, the Hyperline knock-off). Only these abilities reach the top bar; the world healthbars show no stun icons at all (styles/dlf/dlf_status_world.css). Generic stuns use modifiers.vdata's modifier_citadel_stunned (and _no_cc_diminish); Abrams' ultimate applies modifier_citadel_knockdown (seen with cl_modifier_dump), visible only while it stuns. All three are made visible, so every such stun shows. maxSeconds: a heuristic threshold per ability (roughly twice the base VData duration, not a proven bound: ETechDuration items and upgrades can lengthen effects); a radial whose full turn is longer shows its icon without a number. Reason: the user saw a number near Wraith's cooldown on a lifted enemy (2026-10-20); the cause (a status without its own duration whose radial follows the cooldown) is a hypothesis, not traced. A genuine duration above the threshold is suppressed too. ignoreClasses: status panels of the ability with any of these classes are not shown (Bebop's hook: the bullet amp after the pull, user 2026-10-20; Bebop's own hook and the post-pull slow are left stock-hidden).

classSwaps._why: Client CCitadel_Modifier_HookTarget::IsHidden always returns true (client.dll 6785 rva 0xdc4550), so the hooked target never gets a status panel. Its base class modifier_citadel_link decodes the same network payload, keeps the chain effect and uses the VData hidden check; m_AG2BaseAction restores the lifted pose. Known cost, accepted by the user 2026-10-16: on the observer's screen the victim is not pulled (HookTarget's client motion controller is gone); the server is unaffected.

_pulseWhy: pulse: true (Observer HUD, and DLF since 2026-10-24): the top-bar slot pulses once per hit, i.e. each time a status panel of the ability appears or its radial restarts. Shining Wonder's orb slows each hero it bounces on for SlowDuration 1.5 s (VData, client 6819) and the user asked for one pulse per bounce on a head (2026-10-23).
_unnamedWhy: Listed modifiers with no localized name (neither m_sLocalizationName nor an ability/modifier key in resource/localization/*_english.txt, client 6813). Unhidden, the watched hero's own HUD printed the raw token, e.g. #Citadel_Ability_Hook/modifier_citadel_hooktarget (live 2026-10-22), so they also get m_eHudDisplayLocation DISPLAY_HUD_NONE. Stock pairs NONE with OVERHEAD_DRAW_FOR_EVERYONE (e.g. modifier_zipline_boost), so the world healthbar still lists them.
